why: Android Authority and Tom's Hardware both tested chargers and picked a retractable-cable model (the Baseus Enercore) as a top choice, and Macworld's MacBook charger guide names the Ugreen retractable. MacRumors, Macworld and How-To Geek each tested one model on its own. So several major reviewers answer this in part with testing. But none compares the retractable chargers against each other for laptop use. A focused comparison page could get into the results, but it would be up against these well-known names.
